Rashi on Menachot 3a:11:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן ודילמא זו אמר - כלומר, אכתי לא מינכרא, דסברי: קושטא קאמר, דלשום מרחשת נדר, ומיעבר עבר ואתייה במחבת. ודקא אמרת: כיון דאתייה במחבת מחבת הויא, איכא למימר: לא היא, דדילמא מנחה זו אביא במרחשת אמר, דתו לא מצי לשנוייה למחבת:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:11:1.english: This is our reading: And perhaps he said "This" - That is to say, [the priest's improper intention] is still not recognizably [false], for [people] will think that he is speaking the truth, that [the owner] vowed [to bring an offering] for the sake of a deep pan, and he transgressed and brought it in a pan. And as for that which you said: "Since he brought it in a pan, it is a pan [meal offering]"—one can say: That is not so, for perhaps he said: "This meal offering I shall bring in a deep pan," in which case he can no longer change it to a pan.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:12:1.hebrew: לרבנן - דאמרי ה"ז פסולה, הכי נמי דאיכא למימר ולמיפרך הכי. ואנן כרבי שמעון קמיירי, ור"ש אומר התם: האומר הרי עלי במחבת והביא במרחשת, אף ידי נדרו יצא, אלמא קביעותא דמנא לאו כלום היא:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:12:1.english: According to the Rabbis - Who say [that] it is disqualified, it is indeed so, that there is [room] to say and to object like this. But we are dealing according to Rabbi Shimon, and Rabbi Shimon says there: "One who says: 'It is incumbent upon me [to bring a meal offering] in a pan,' and he brought [it] in a deep pan, has even fulfilled his vow." Evidently, the designation of the vessel is nothing.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:12:2.hebrew: לא שנא אמר עלי ולא שנא אמר ה"ז - הילכך, כי אתייה במחבת – מחבת הויא, וכי קמץ לה לשום מרחשת – מחשבה דמינכרא הויא. אבל גבי זבחים, איכא למימר: מיעבר עבר ושחטינהו בדרום. ואי קשיא: גבי חטאת העוף לישני ליה הכי, דסברי עולת העוף הוא ומיעבר עבר? הא ליכא למיפרך, דתרי איסורי לא מחזקינן ליה: חדא – דעביד ליה הזאה, ועוד – דקא עביד ליה למטה:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:12:2.english: There is no difference whether he said: "[It is incumbent] upon me," and there is no difference whether he said: "This is..." - Therefore, when he brought it in a pan, it is [deemed] a pan [meal offering]; and when [the priest] removed a handful of it for the sake of a deep pan, it is a recognizably [false] intent. However, in the case of animal sacrifices, it can be said [that onlookers assume]: He transgressed and slaughtered them in the south. And if a difficulty is raised: Regarding a bird sin offering, let [the Gemara] answer it in this manner—that [onlookers] assume it is a bird burnt offering and he transgressed? [This] cannot be raised as a challenge, for we do not presume [that a person committed] two prohibited acts: one, that he performed sprinkling [instead of squeezing]; and furthermore, that he performed it below [the red line].

Rashi on Menachot 3a:13:1.english: A burnt offering is male, and a sin offering is female.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:14:1.hebrew: אמר הריני שוחטה לשם יחיד מאי איכא למימר - הא ודאי ידעינן דחטאת יחיד נקבה היא, כשבה או שעירה:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:14:1.english: [If] he said, "I am hereby slaughtering it for the sake of [a sin offering of] an individual," what can be said? - For surely we know that the sin offering of an individual is female, [either] a female lamb or a female goat.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:14:2.hebrew: ותו דחטאת יחיד - נקבה היא, והביא נקבה לעזרה ושחטה לשם עולה, מאי איכא למימר:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:14:2.english: And furthermore, that a sin offering of an individual - It is female, and he brought a female into the [Temple] courtyard and slaughtered it for the sake of a burnt offering — what can be said?

Rashi on Menachot 3a:14:3.hebrew: מיכסיא - נקבות דרחל באליה, בזנבה, ולא ידיעה:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:14:3.english: It is covered - The femaleness of a ewe [is covered] by its fat tail, [meaning] by its tail, and is not discernible.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:15:1.hebrew: שעירה - דאין לה זנב, מאי איכא למימר:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:15:1.english: A female goat - Since it has no tail [to cover it], what can be said?

Rashi on Menachot 3a:16:1.hebrew: אשם נזיר ומצורע - כתיב בהו כבש, וכל כבש בן שנה הוא במסכת פרה (פ"א מ"ג):
Rashi on Menachot 3a:16:1.english: The guilt offering of a nazirite and a leper - It is written concerning them "lamb," and every lamb is in its first year, [as taught] in tractate Parah (chapter 1, mishna 3).

Rashi on Menachot 3a:17:1.hebrew: אשם גזילות - דכתיב בויקרא: והשיב את הגזילה אשר גזל וגו' ואת אשמו יביא וגו' (ויקרא ה׳:כ״ג), ואשם מעילות בני ב' שנים נינהו, דכתיב בהו איל (שם):
Rashi on Menachot 3a:17:1.english: A guilt offering for robbery - As it is written in Leviticus: "And he shall restore that which he stole, etc., and he shall bring his guilt offering, etc." (Leviticus 5:23), and [both this] and a guilt offering for misuse are in their second year, as it is written regarding them: "a ram" (ibid.).

Rashi on Menachot 3a:17:2.hebrew: ותו אשם גזילות ומעילות - דאיתנהו בדינייהו בני ב' שנים, ושחטן לשם פסח, לירצו:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:17:2.english: And furthermore, a guilt offering for robbery and misuse - Which by their laws are in their second year, and one slaughtered them for the sake of a Paschal offering, they should effect acceptance.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:19:1.english: A guilt offering - It comes only from sheep.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:19:2.hebrew: דהאי צמר - אשם כבשים יש לו צמר, ושעיר אין לו צמר אלא שיער בעלמא, ודבר גלוי לכל הוא:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:19:2.english: For this [has] wool - A guilt offering of sheep has wool, and a he-goat does not have wool, but merely hair, and it is a matter evident to all.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:19:3.hebrew: אמרי דיכרא אוכמא הוא - סברי: איל שחור הוא, ולהכי נקט אוכמא, דסתם שעירים שחורים הן:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:19:3.english: They say: It is a black ram - [People] assume: "It is a black ram." And that is why [the Gemara] specified "black," as ordinary goats are black.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:1:1.hebrew: אמרי - אינשי: ודאי חטאת היא, והך מיצוי דבתר הזאה הוא. והאי דקעביד לה למעלה, הא קאמר וכו':
Rashi on Menachot 3a:1:1.english: They say - People [say]: "It is certainly a sin offering, and this squeezing is [the squeezing] that follows sprinkling." And [as for] the fact that he performs it above — behold, [the Gemara] states: ["As the Master said...", etc.]

Rashi on Menachot 3a:20:1.hebrew: עגל ופר - חטאת, כגון פר כהן משיח, ששחטו לשם פסח ואשם, שאין באין אלא מן הצאן, לירצו:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:20:1.english: A calf and a bull - [Brought as a] sin offering, such as the bull of the anointed priest, which one slaughtered for the sake of a Passover offering or a guilt offering — which come only from the flock — should effect acceptance.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:3:1.english: Indeed so - For certainly Rabbi Shimon concedes regarding it that it is valid.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:3:2.hebrew: ולא לעופות - דודאי לעופות דומין, דעופות עלו לשם חובה, כגון חטאת העוף שהזה דמה למטה לשם עולת העוף:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:3:2.english: And not to bird offerings - For [meal offerings] are certainly similar to bird offerings, as bird offerings count toward fulfillment of the obligation, such as a bird sin offering whose blood [the priest] sprinkled below for the sake of a bird burnt offering.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:5:1.hebrew: אימר דאמר רחמנא אף בדרום - דלא קבע להו צפון, כדקבע לחטאת ואשם ועולה, דכתיב בעולה: על ירך המזבח צפונה (ויקרא א), וכתיב בחטאת: במקום אשר תשחט העולה תשחט החטאת (שם ו), וכן באשם:
Rashi on Menachot 3a:5:1.english: Say that the Merciful One said: Even in the south - That He did not designate the north for them [offerings of lesser sanctity], as He designated for a sin offering, a guilt offering, and a burnt offering. For it is written concerning a burnt offering: "On the side of the altar northward" (Leviticus 1), and it is written concerning a sin offering: "In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered shall the sin offering be slaughtered" (ibid. 6), and similarly regarding a guilt offering.

Rashi on Menachot 3a:8:1.english: And that which he removes a handful from it in a deep pan - That is to say, for the sake of a deep-pan [meal offering].

Rashi on Menachot 3a:9:1.english: It is a pan [meal offering] - And [people] know that he is lying.

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:12:1.hebrew: אלמא קביעותא דמנא לאו כלום הוא - ובפרק בתרא (לקמן מנחות דף קד:) תנן: פירשתי ואיני יודע מה פירשתי, יביא חמשתן; ומוקי לה בגמרא כר"ש. והיכי אתיא כוותיה דר"ש? הא לר"ש, אפי' פירש מחבת והביא מרחשת, יצא! ושמא התם בבא לצאת ידי שמים. ואי נמי, כגון דאיכא חדא דמייתי וקאמר: אם זו נדרתי תהא לנדרי, ואם לאו תהא נדבה:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:12:1.english: Evidently, the designation of the vessel is nothing - And in the last chapter (below, Menachot 104b), we learned: [If one said,] "I specified [which meal offering I would bring], but I do not know what I specified," he must bring all five of them; and [the Gemara] establishes it in accordance with Rabbi Shimon. But how does it align with [the opinion of] Rabbi Shimon? For according to Rabbi Shimon, even if he specified a pan (machavat) and brought a deep pan (marcheshet), he has fulfilled [his obligation]! And perhaps there, [it is a case where] he comes to fulfill [his obligation] in the eyes of Heaven. Or alternatively, for example, where there is one [meal offering] that he brings and says: "If this is what I vowed, let it be for my vow, and if not, let it be a gift offering (nedavah)."

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:12:2.hebrew: לא שנא אמר עלי ולא שנא אמר זו - הקשה הרב ר' יצחק בן הר"ר מאיר: תינח מחבת לשם מרחשת, אלא חריבה לשם בלולה, אמרי: הא בלולה היא, ומיעבר הוא דעבר ועביד לה חריבה? וכן בלולה לשם חריבה? ויש לומר, דבהא לא טעי אינש שיעשה חריבה בלולה ובלולה חריבה. ועוד י"ל, דניחא בלאו הכי, בין למ"ד מנחה קדושה בלא שמן, בין למ"ד אין מנחה קדושה בלא שמן; לקמן צ"ע:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:12:2.english: [There is] no difference [whether] he said: "[It is incumbent] upon me," and [there is] no difference [whether] he said: "This" - The teacher Rabbi Yitzchak, son of the teacher Rabbi Meir (Ribam), raised a difficulty: Granted [that it is well regarding] a pan [meal offering offered] for the sake of a deep-pan [meal offering]; but regarding a dry [meal offering offered] for the sake of a mixed [meal offering], would [people not] say: "This is [designated as] a mixed [meal offering], and he transgressed and made it dry"? And similarly, [if one offered] a mixed [meal offering] for the sake of a dry [one]? And it can be said that in this [matter], a person would not err [to suspect] that one would make a dry [meal offering] mixed, or a mixed [meal offering] dry. And furthermore, it can be said that it is resolved even without this, whether according to the one who says [that] a meal offering is sanctified without oil, or according to the one who says [that] a meal offering is not sanctified without oil; [and] later [in the tractate] this requires further study.

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:13:1.hebrew: כיון דאיכא שעיר נשיא - ואם עולה זו איל, אמרי: שעיר נשיא הוא, כדאמרינן בסמוך: אמרי דיכרא אוכמא הוא:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:13:1.english: Since there is the goat of a prince - And if this burnt offering is a ram, they say: "It is the goat of a prince," as we say nearby: They say: "It is a black ram."

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:17:1.hebrew: אמר לשם אשם גזילות לשם אשם מעילות מאי איכא למימר - וא"ת: אכתי אמרי, דאי עבר עבר ומייתי ליה בן שנה; דהאמר בתמורה בפרק אלו קדשים (תמורה דף יט:): אשם בן שנה והביאו בן שתים, בן שתים והביאו בן שנה — כשירה, אלא שלא עלו לשם חובה? ויש לומר: דרבי שמעון לטעמיה, דאמר התם: כל עצמה אינה קדושה:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:17:1.english: [If] he said, "[I slaughter it] for the sake of a guilt offering for robbery [or] for the sake of a guilt offering for misuse [of consecrated property]," what can be said? - And if you say: Still, let [onlookers] say that if he transgressed, he transgressed [and bedi'avad it is valid], and he is bringing it as a yearling; for didn't [the Baraita] state in Temurah, in the chapter [entitled] *Ellu Kodashim* (Temurah 19b): "[In the case of] a guilt offering [designated to be] a yearling and one brought it as a two-year-old, [or designated to be] a two-year-old and one brought it as a yearling, it is valid, except that it did not count toward [fulfilling one's] obligation"? And one can say: Rabbi Shimon follows his [own] reasoning, as he said there: "It itself is not consecrated at all."

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:19:1.hebrew: דהאי צמר והאי שיער - צמר לבן, כדכתיב (ישעיהו א׳:י״ח) אם יאדימו כתולע כצמר יהיו; שיער שחור, כדמשמע בריש המוציא יין (שבת דף עז:): מאי טעמא עיזי מסגי ברישא והדר אימרי? כברייתו של עולם: ברישא חשוכא והדר נהורא. והיינו דקאמר הכא: אמרי דיכרא אוכמא הוא. ובקונטרס לא פירש כן:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:19:1.english: For this is wool and that is hair - "Wool" [means] white, as it is written: "Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool" (Isaiah 1:18). "Hair" [means] black, as is implied at the beginning of [the chapter] "HaMotzi Yayin" (Shabbat 77b): "What is the reason goats walk in front and then sheep [follow]? According to the creation of the world: first darkness, and then light." And that is why [the Gemara] says here: "They will say: It is a black ram." And in the Kuntres [Rashi], he did not explain so.

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:1:1.hebrew: מיצה דמה בכל מקום במזבח כשירה - אע"ג דכתיב בה יסוד, כדכתיב (ויקרא ה׳:ט׳) ימצה אל יסוד המזבח, האמרינן בפרק חטאת העוף (זבחים דף סה: ושם) דמיצוי לא מעכב, אפי' לא מיצה כלל; ופלוגתא היא בפ"ב דמעילה (דף ח:):
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:1:1.english: [If] one drained its blood anywhere on the altar, it is valid - Even though "base" is written concerning it, as it is written: "[it] shall be drained out at the base of the altar" (Leviticus 5:9), behold, we say in the chapter of Chatat Ha-Of (Zevachim 65b and ibid.) that draining is not indispensable, even if one did not drain [it] at all; and it is a dispute in the second chapter of Me'ilah (8b).

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:2:1.hebrew: חטאת העוף שהזה דמה - לפי שהתחיל להקשות ממיצוי והזאה, מקשה כמו כן עתה; אבל כמו כן (עתה) היה יכול להקשות ממליקת חטאת שמלקה למטה לשם עולה, דמליקת עולת העוף למעלה, כדאמרי' בזבחים בפרק קדשי קדשים (זבחים דף סה. ושם): מה הקטרה בראשו של מזבח, אף מליקה:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:2:1.english: A bird sin offering whose blood he sprinkled - Because [the Gemara] began to object from draining and sprinkling, it likewise objects now [from sprinkling]; but it could likewise (now) have objected from the pinching of a sin offering that one pinched below for the sake of a burnt offering, for the pinching of a bird burnt offering is [performed] above, as we say in Zevachim in the chapter of Kodshei Kodashim (Zevachim 65a and there): "Just as the burning is at the top of the altar, so too the pinching [is at the top of the altar]."

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:4:1.hebrew: דאי קדשים קלים בדרום הוה עביד להו - ס"ד, משום דלא ליתי למיטעי ולומר שהם קדשי קדשים:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:4:1.english: For if [they were] offerings of lesser sanctity, he would have performed [their slaughter] in the south - It entered [the Gemara's] mind [that he would do so] so that [people] would not come to err and say that they are offerings of the most sacred order.

Tosafot on Menachot 3a:7:1.hebrew: ומיעבר הוא דעבר ושחטינהו בדרום - הא דלא משני הכי לעיל גבי קושיא דחטאת העוף שהזה דמה למטה לשם עולת העוף, פי' בקונטרס משום דאיכא תרתי, ולא טעי שיעשה הזאה ולמטה. ולפירושו קשה, דא"כ תקשי לו מחטאת בהמה לשם עולה, דאיכא תרתי שינויי כדפרישנא לעיל. ונראה דהשתא חוזר בו משינויא דלעיל דלזבחים ולא לעופות, דאכולהו איכא לשנויי דאמרי' מיעבר עבר:
Tosafot on Menachot 3a:7:1.english: And he merely transgressed and slaughtered them in the south - As for [the fact] that [the Gemara] did not answer this way earlier regarding the difficulty of a bird sin offering whose blood [a priest] sprinkled below for the sake of a bird burnt offering, the Kuntres explained that [this is] because there are two [differences], and [a priest] would not err [such] that he would perform sprinkling and [also do so] below. And according to his explanation, it is difficult: for if so, let [the Gemara] raise a difficulty from an animal sin offering [sacrificed] for the sake of a burnt offering, where there are two differences, as we explained above. And it appears that now [the Gemara] retracts from the resolution [offered] above, that [Rabbi Shimon's statement referred] "to slaughtered offerings, but not to birds"; for regarding all of them, one can answer that we say: "He merely transgressed."
